name: Rizuhble's Stubborn Old Geist
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Health
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Getting bursted in lane while you're low from your own bombs. Sell it when slots fill.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-6,400 (levels 1-12). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Soul Exchange unlocked. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Cultist Sacrifice. Ultimate (Soul Exchange) is available from Cultist Sacrifice.

items.name: Monster Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Cultist Sacrifice completes 5,600 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Cultist Sacrifice completes 4.8k weapon in 5600 souls (~5.6 min), 5 purchases

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Bullet Lifesteal, 16800 souls (~16.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Mystic Regeneration
items.why: spirit investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Bullet Resist Shredder, 14400 souls (~14.4 min) later and spirit is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Stamina
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Bullet Lifesteal, 15200 souls (~15.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Kinetic Dash
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Cultist Sacrifice completes 2,400 souls on. Upgrade of Extra Stamina (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Cultist Sacrifice completes 4.8k weapon in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Cultist Sacrifice
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 46% weapon damage. Upgrade of Monster Rounds (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 6,400-20,000 (levels 12-25). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Life Drain T3, Malice T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Essence Bomb, damage) grows from 113 to 176. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Bullet Resist Shredder, vitality 4.8k at Bullet Lifesteal.

items.name: Radiant Regeneration
items.why: spirit investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Bullet Resist Shredder, 8000 souls (~8.0 min) later and spirit is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Your own bombs hurt you with spirit damage, so this cuts that too.

items.name: Berserker
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 46 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Bullet Resist Shredder
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power.

items.name: Bullet Lifesteal
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (4,000 to 5,600 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus.

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 5,600 to 7,200 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 20,000-30,400 (levels 25-30). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Soul Exchange T3.

items.name: Healing Booster
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 7,200 to 8,000 invested: bonus 42 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Spellslinger
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 8,000 to 14,400 invested: bonus 62 to 74% weapon damage.

items.name: Blood Tribute
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 14,400 to 17,600 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 30,400-43,200 (levels 30-34). Your biggest single spirit hit (Essence Bomb, damage) grows from 183 to 271.

items.name: Leech
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 8,000 to 11,200 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Life Drain (3 to 4).

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Life Drain (4 to 5). Takes spirit from 5,600 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 52 spirit power. Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 216s of base cooldown across your kit, 170s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Takes spirit from 8,000 to 14,400 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Berserker? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Kinetic Dash.
sections.desc: Dying after Berserker? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Kinetic Dash.

items.name: Warp Stone
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: They dive you and you've got no way out.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Silences and hexes keep shutting down your abilities.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: Lash ult, Infernus ult. Anything big you can see coming.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry is melting you.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Stuns keep cutting your drain and Soul Exchange.

items.name: Spellbreaker
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Big spirit bursts keep killing you.

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Their burst kills you before you can swap. Don't buy it if they have Cursed Relic.

items.name: Inhibitor
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 11,200 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Silencer
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Crippling Headshot
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 17,600 to 24,000 invested: bonus 86 to 100% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Sell Bullet Resist Shredder for this.

items.name: Ricochet
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 17,600 to 22,400 invested: bonus 86 to 100% weapon damage.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Healing Tempo
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Healing Booster for 4,800 more souls: bonus fire rate 0 to 35; tech resist 0 to 10..
